title: Practical Advantages of Online Conformal Prediction for Data Streams
abstract: arXiv:2610.27740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full conformal prediction offers finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees under exchangeability, but exact computation can be costly, while its classical guarantees do not directly extend to non-stationary data streams. We compare four sequential conformal regression procedures with a weighted full-conformal benchmark in terms of empirical coverage, prediction interval width, and computational cost. The procedures combine ordinary or forgetting-factor least squares with uniform or exponentially weighted empirical residual quantiles, or with online gradient-based quantile tracking. Experiments cover an independent and identically distributed control, two synthetic distribution-shift scenarios, and four real-world data streams. Adapting the regression model as well as the conformal threshold substantially improves the coverage--width tradeoff under drift. The quantile-tracking procedure requires $O(p^2)$ time and memory per observation

translated_title: 在线保形预测在数据流场景下的实用优势
translated_abstract: 完全保形预测在可交换性假设下能够提供有限样本边际覆盖保证，但其精确计算代价可能很高，且其经典保证无法直接扩展到非平稳数据流。我们在经验覆盖率、预测区间宽度和计算成本三个维度上，将四种顺序保形回归方法与加权完全保形基准进行了比较。这些方法将普通最小二乘或遗忘因子最小二乘与均匀加权或指数加权的经验残差分位数相结合，或与基于在线梯度的分位数跟踪方法相结合。实验涵盖一个独立同分布对照组、两个合成分布漂移场景以及四个真实世界数据流。结果表明，同时自适应调整回归模型和保形阈值能够显著改善漂移条件下的覆盖率-区间宽度权衡。分位数跟踪方法每次观测仅需 $O(p^2)$ 的时间与内存开销。
tldr: 该研究系统比较了四种在线保形回归方法，证明同时自适应更新回归模型和保形阈值可显著提升非平稳数据流下的覆盖率与区间宽度权衡，其中基于梯度的分位数跟踪方法每次观测仅需 O(p²) 的计算与内存成本。
